description: This file defines an interface 'ITransactionalResourceExtension' for transactional resource extensions within Orleans transactions. It includes method signatures for commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare operations, each associated with transaction management.

classes.name: ITransactionalResourceExtension
classes.description: An interface extending IGrainExtension, providing methods for transactionally managing resources with attributes indicating transaction behavior and concurrency control.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Performs a commit operation for a read-only transaction, returning a TransactionalStatus.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the transaction with a specified status.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a resource for a transaction, involving setup with access count and participant info.
